title: Thai-Style Cha Buns
description: A fusion of Vietnamese cha and Thai flavors, these crispy buns are filled with savory, spicy tofu.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
2. Divide the bun dough into small balls and flatten each into a disk.
3. In a separate pan, heat the cha seasoning and fish sauce over low heat.
4. Add the tofu to the pan and stir to coat with the cha seasoning mixture.
5. Place a disk of bun dough in the hot oil and fry until crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
6. Repeat with the remaining dough disks.
7. Stuff each bun with the tofu mixture, then top with a few slices of Thai chili and a sprinkle of cilantro.
8. Serve immediately with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of salt.
